commands.command: set -eu; BASE=4462a5246e06f7cebcb5808eace2d6278988e56e; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"; git checkout --detach "$BASE" >/dev/null; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo CHART_AUDIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo '=== CHART_REFS ==='; git grep -n -Ei 'Sparkline|sparkline|chart|Chart|sensorReadings|samplesBySensorId|readingHistory|measurementHistory' -- apps/mobile/src packages docs || true; echo '=== HISTORY_REFS ==='; git grep -n -Ei 'history|readings|samples' -- apps/mobile/src packages/ui/src packages/automation-core/src packages/ble-core/src || true; echo '=== CHART_FILES ==='; git ls-files | grep -Ei '(spark|chart|history|reading)' || true; echo CHART_REMOVAL_AUDIT_OK=1
